# IISTE - International Institute for Science Technology and Education

> IISTE is a comprehensive academic publishing and hosting platform offering peer-reviewed journals, book publishing, and conference management services across multiple disciplines.

IISTE provides open-access academic publishing solutions with DOI assignment, manuscript peer-review, and hosting for multidisciplinary journals spanning sciences, engineering, business, education, and social sciences. The platform supports journal migration, new journal launches, and special issue creation alongside book publishing services.

## Key Topics

- Academic journals
- Open-access publishing
- Peer-review process
- Author guidelines
- Manuscript submission
- Journal directory
- Book publishing
- Academic hosting
- Publication workflow
- DOI assignment
- Multidisciplinary journals
- Special issues
- Journal migration
- ISBN support
- Open access policy

## Journal Publishing

- [Journals Directory](https://www.iiste.org/journals): IISTE journals directory with DOI assignment and peer-review process
- [All IISTE Journals](https://www.iiste.org/all-the-iiste-journals): Complete directory of IISTE journals across multiple disciplines
- [Author Guidelines](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/author-guidelines): Author guidelines with paper templates and submission process documentation
- [Open Access Policy and Ethics](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/open-access-policy-and-ethics): IISTE open access policy, ethics standards and plagiarism prevention
- [Start a New Journal](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/start-a-new-journal-with-iiste): Instructions for starting a new journal with IISTE hosting platform
- [Migrate a Journal](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/migrate-a-journal-or-start-a-new-one-with-iiste): Guide for journal migration and starting new journals with IISTE platform
- [Start a Special Issue](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/start-a-special-issue-with-iiste-journals): Guidelines for creating special issues with IISTE journals

## Subject-Specific Journal Collections

- [Business, Economics, Finance and Management](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/business-economics-finance-and-management-journals): Business, economics, finance and management journals directory
- [Education, Culture and Social Sciences](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/education-culture-and-social-sciences-journals): Education, culture and social sciences journals directory
- [Development Studies, Public Policy and Law](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/development-studies-public-policy-law-journals): Development studies, public policy and law journals directory
- [Physical Sciences, Mathematics and Chemistry](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/physical-sciences-mathematics-and-chemistry-journals): Physical sciences, mathematics, chemistry and engineering journals
- [Life Sciences, Food and Medical Sciences](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/life-science-food-and-medical-sciences-journals): Life sciences, medical and agricultural journals directory
- [Environment, Civil and Materials Sciences](https://www.iiste.org/journals-2/environment-civil-materials-sciences-journals): Environmental, civil engineering and materials science journals
- [Co-Hosted Journals](https://www.iiste.org/co-hosted-journals): Co-hosted journals including pharmacy, environmental and scientific research

## Book Publishing

- [Book Publishing Services](https://www.iiste.org/book): IISTE book publishing services for academic and independent authors
- [Publish a Book with IISTE](https://www.iiste.org/book/publish-a-book-with-iiste): Book publishing guide with author guidelines and ISBN support
- [Call for Book Chapters](https://www.iiste.org/book/call-for-book-chapters): Call for book chapters across engineering, education and social sciences
- [Recent Books](https://www.iiste.org/book/recent-books): Catalog of recent IISTE publications with ISBN information
